name: Sub Line Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Sounds and patterns for Sub Line, a mono synth with a sub oscillator, a two-stage lowpass filter, a 32-step pattern and an arpeggiator. Nine styles: Techno, House, Deep House, Acid, Electro, Synthwave, Hip-hop, Dub, Drum & Bass and Trance, with basses, leads, pads, plucks, stabs, patterns and arpeggios. Pattern tunes bring their own bassline or sequence; the other tunes are meant to be played from a keyboard or another device.
